top_choice_rationale: Theta-13 from Daya Bay and RENO is a mature, decade-confirmed discovery about nature that could not have been deduced and that fixed the design of DUNE, Hyper-Kamiokande and JUNO; it is distinct from the 2015 oscillation prize. I accept the attribution risk in a three-spokesperson credit, so the optical lattice clock (P001) is my clear second, with broader support and cleaner credit but more instrument than discovery, then the topological insulator proposal (P003), whose three-name cut omits Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang. All three beat no award.
